description:
The heroine, though a little slow-witted, is kind and incredibly strong. To earn money, she starts working part-time at a maid café. One day, a handsome man who seems completely out of place in such a setting appears—and he even singles her out by name! “Oishikunare~! Moe moe kyun!” Unfazed by embarrassment, the heroine shouts the chant loudly right in front of the handsome customer. Surprisingly, despite his own shyness, the man follows along with every single word of her cheer. But that night, on her way home, the heroine senses a suspicious presence tailing her. Acting on instinct, she lands a solid punch on her pursuer—only to discover it’s none other than the very same handsome customer who had so passionately echoed her chant earlier!

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/maid_cafe), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/maid_cafe), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000077999), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14073663), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=260328)
